{"command":"git add "Twin — Roadmap.md" fs.go fs_test.go go.mod update.go update_test.go && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Move across filesystems, keep file attributes, stop favorites key leak

Close the last High bugs of Phase 0:

- Moves fall back to copy, flush (syncfs) and delete when rename fails
  with EXDEV, so moving to a USB drive works. A failed copy leaves the
  source untouched and removes its partial copy, including read-only
  directories. A directory moved onto an existing one is merged.
- Copies keep mode and mtime, can copy read-only directories, replace
  files atomically through a temporary file, and refuse FIFOs and
  devices instead of hanging on them. A directory is never copied or
  moved through a symlink at the destination.
- The favorites popup no longer passes keys through to the pane.

Cross-device moves are tested by simulating EXDEV; TestMoveAcrossRealDevices
runs a real one when TWIN_XDEV_DIR points at another filesystem.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
